⊙.justification: The identity of the ear as a self-modeling system where the weaver becomes the weave; the ear knows itself as the ear.

∈.justification: The co-multiplication where the single acoustic field splits into two distinct spatial arms (left and right ears) for stereo processing.

∋.justification: The multiplication where the two binaural arms rejoin into a single resolved spatial verdict, often holding both timing and intensity differences.

⊥.justification: The constructive falsity where a frequency is refuted by the lack of resonance at a specific cochlear location.

⊞.justification: The state where two slightly different frequencies are held simultaneously, creating a phantom beat that is both present and absent.

⊡.justification: The permanent, append-only record of a sound event fixed in the hippocampal engram.

steps.domain_action: The system begins in the pre-ontological deep, the unmarked void before any distinction of sound.
The skull boundary is established as the closed container for the auditory system.
Sound waves enter the outer ear and propagate forward toward the tympanic membrane.
The acoustic field splits into two distinct arms representing the left and right ears.
The left ear arm processes the incoming sound wave through the ossicular chain.
The left ear affirms the presence of a specific frequency via tonotopic resonance.
The mechanical energy chains into the fluid dynamics of the cochlea.
The left ear recognizes its own state as a localized sensory point.
The right ear arm processes the incoming sound wave through the ossicular chain.
The right ear refutes the presence of a slightly different frequency due to lack of resonance.
The mechanical energy chains into the fluid dynamics of the right cochlea.
The right ear recognizes its own state as a localized sensory point.
The system holds both the affirmed frequency and the refuted frequency simultaneously as a binaural beat.
The neural feedback descends from the brainstem to modulate the cochlear amplifier.
The two binaural arms rejoin to form a unified spatial perception, resolving the time and level differences.
The auditory event is permanently recorded in the memory trace.
The system returns to the closed boundary state, ready for the next cycle.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The tonotopic map translates acoustic frequencies into spatial positions on the basilar membrane.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The auditory nerve fibers communicate action potentials between the cochlea and the brainstem.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The hippocampus stores the fixed auditory traces as permanent engrams.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The phase-locking mechanism determines the timing of neural firing relative to the sound wave.
phase_5.alfs_store: The canonical reference is the O∞ winding primitive that encodes the integer winding number of the cochlear spiral.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Metabolic energy consumed by the outer hair cells to amplify sound.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The cochlear fluid is in a state of potential energy before the sound wave arrives.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The cochlear fluid is in a state of kinetic energy after the sound wave has passed.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The cycle is entropy-conservative because the energy input from the sound wave is balanced by the metabolic output of the cochlear amplifier.
